method: Exposed agent-authored paragraph-level coverage review; not human-adjudicated gold labels. Gaps mean adequate support was not identified in this bounded retained corpus, not that evidence does not exist.

status_definitions.direct: Direct study-specific support identified for the need; not exhaustive or universally generalizable.
status_definitions.partial: Support exists only for a subset or adjacent/general workflow context; preserve the stated missing part.
status_definitions.gap: Adequate support for the stated need was not identified; do not infer an answer from adjacent material.

rows.scope_and_limit: General boundary difficulty; no judgment about a displayed lesion.
Specific phase/protocol description; no controlled optimum or current-patient scan recommendation.
Study-defined isoattenuation and detection limitations; no patient classification.
Indirect localization and selected-cohort limitations; indirect signs do not establish an exact boundary.
Fixed acquisition, partial-volume and motion/processing limitations; no complete artifact/noise delineation study.
Study-specific maximal axial/coronal/sagittal/3D diameters and segmented tumor volume; not a universal protocol.
Study-specific inter- and intra-reader agreement with reader/sample/metric conditions.
Diameter/volume methods and full-extent rationale for irregular lesions; study-specific limitations. No universal conversion, uncertainty propagation, or patient prognosis.
Research contour extent, independent outlining and adjudication; not a complete internal-appearance protocol.
Adjacency context only; not evidence of which neighbouring structures are commonly confused.
Study-specific subregion heuristics and annotation; no universal boundary convention or full landmark consensus.
Length range plus small MRI control-group volume (mean +/- SEM), and review-level age/fat morphology context. No population reference interval or CT patient comparison.
No verified duct inclusion/exclusion contour rule. Attenuation ROI exclusions and duct signs are different tasks.
Low-overlap failure frequency; lacks a spatial false-positive/error-region taxonomy.
Reported difficult appearances and cohort limitations; no causal size/appearance failure analysis.
Patient-split and held-center evidence under specified prompting; broader populations remain unproven.
No validated segmentation confidence/calibration method identified. A statement that uncertainty was not evaluated is insufficient.
Reference-crop and prompt dependencies; no matched causal ablation of localization error propagation.
Explicit target, metrics, splits and prompting conditions; reference-derived prompts are not autonomous detection.
General prostate radiotherapy review evidence; cannot infer pancreatic clinical safety or full error detection.
Possible automation bias with an alternative conscious-adequacy explanation; no causal pancreas-specific demonstration.
General workflow agreement/quality comparison; correction time and pancreatic clinical benefit not measured.
Study-specific annotator roles, independent/mutual review and senior correction.
Publisher-reported public annotation provenance; missing/empty-label semantics absent and no local dataset audit.
Uncertain boundary exclusion and altered-anatomy limits; no complete truncation/absent-label policy.
